# FormAI STUDIO

> AI-powered interior visualization, furniture creation, real-time image editing, and cinematic design video tools by VICK ROB INC.

FormAI STUDIO helps designers and clients transform references, plans, photographs, and original ideas into photorealistic spaces and reusable furniture concepts.

## Pages

- [About](/about): Learn about FormAI STUDIO and VICK ROB INC.
- [AI Tools](/tools): Explore the complete creative AI toolkit.
- [Studio AI](/studio): Create interiors using exact furniture reference images.
- [3D to AI](/model-to-ai): Transform design perspectives into photorealistic renderings.
- [AI Edits](/ai-edits): Refine furniture, materials, textures, colors, and lighting.
- [Photo to AI](/photo-to-ai): Edit room photographs through an AI conversation.
- [AI to Video](/ai-to-video): Turn rendering sequences into cinematic design videos.
- [Create Furniture](/create): Design custom furniture with shapes, textures, and references.
- [Community](/feed): Discover public furniture and interior creations.
- [Contact](/contact): Get support and contact information.
